text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - post-deploy wave: elevated tail latency + throughput drop observed in runtime after release v2026-03. Canary nodes reporting kernel-fallbacks and batching stalls. Paging eng-oncall (devon)

maya: saw the alert, adding @devon @samir. AcmeCorp and a few other customers are hitting higher latencies per monitoring. :eyes:

devon: on it. Initial check: canary pool latency p90->p99 increased, throughput down ~25%. Logs show repeated kernel fallback messages and batch flushes.

samir: any recent infra flags or sched changes in this rollout?

maya: rollout was a staged wave with feature flag release_2026_03 enabled for canary. No infra scheduler changes planned.

jenn: product FYI — we have 2 paying customers on canary (AcmeCorp + ByteLabs). AcmeCorp reported slower chat responses ~10m ago.

devon: grabbing tail logs from one canary instance:
```
[2026-03-17T15:22:01Z] WARN kernel_fallback: kernel mismatch -> falling back to generic kernel
[2026-03-17T15:22:02Z] INFO batch: flush after timeout, pending=48
[2026-03-17T15:22:03Z] WARN prefetch: eviction loop detected
```

devon: looks like some models hit a codepath that triggers non-optimized kernels causing CPU stalls and batch queueing. That explains latency and throughput drop.

samir: can we flip the feature flag for canary to kill the new runtime path? If the flag exists, toggle then observe.

maya: flag release_2026_03 exists and is sticky. I can flip for the canary orgs only. Doing now.

maya: toggled release_2026_03 -> off for CANARY orgs. Monitoring metrics... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: action taken: feature flag toggled by maya at 2026-03-17T15:27:14Z.

devon: seeing immediate improvement on one node: p99 down ~40%, throughput recovering. But some nodes still on fallback. We'll need to roll back the release for any remaining canary capacity.

deploy-bot: rollback-start v2026-03 -> previous-stable triggered by devon. ETA ~4m per region.

samir: while rollback proceeds, start draining affected canary hosts and force kernel affinity to legacy where possible:
`kubectl annotate pod <pod> runtime.kernel_affinity=legacy --overwrite`

devon: doing drain+affinity on two canary pods now.

jenn: contacting AcmeCorp support lead to explain mitigation and potential short-term impact. Will offer status update once rollback completes.

ops-alerts: note: alert rate for runtime.kernel_fallback increased by 12x at 15:20Z and is trending down after flag toggle.

devon: rollback completed in us-west-2 canary slice. Metrics stabilized there. Continuing rollbacks/cleanups in eu-central and ap-south.

maya: started a quick postmortem doc and capturing timelines: toggled flag at 15:27, rollback started 15:29, full canary rollback complete 15:36.

samir: follow-ups: 1) pin test harness to exercise kernel codepath for the affected model, 2) add automatic kill-switch in rollout pipeline to flip flags if p99 > 2x baseline, 3) ensure deploy-bot can auto-rollback when kernel_fallback alert fires thrice.

devon: handing off to runtime oncall (samir) for root cause. I'll remain available for customer comms.

samir: acknowledged, taking lead for RC and RCA. Will run targeted repro on staging and capture kernel mismatches.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> rollback & flag kill executed. Severity: reduced to P2 for RCA work. Next update scheduled in 2h. :white_check_mark:
